第50章 处长居然单独给奖励-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安把天珠从空间里取出来。

在手心里，掂了掂。

重量没有变化，外观也看不出什么区别。顾承安起身去把智能眼镜也拿了出来。

按照助手的指引，把智能眼镜和天珠一起放回系统空间，启动适配升级流程。

助手提示：预计耗时五分钟。

这次快多了。

五分钟一过他迫不及待的取出天珠和智能眼镜。

先把天珠挂回脖子上。

戴上眼镜。

开机，镜片右上角的半透明界面弹出来，和之前一样，但多了一个图标——小小的天珠形状，悬在界面角落里。

他把眼镜用蓝牙连上手机，点开那个图标。

之前天珠记录的信息，全部同步过来了，一条一条，还算比较清晰。

但真正想要的那个实时扫描标记的功能还没办法验证，毕竟现在还没有目标。

顾承安摘下眼镜，放进系统空间。

明天出去转一圈，实测一下。

今天的收获还行：钱到账了，重要辅助设备升级好了，顺带还在大梅沙当了回编外救生员。

正义值这边，不知道今天算不算有进账。

他打开系统界面瞄了一眼。

正义值：7555。

多了200。

还不错，意外收获。

他在心里默默换算了一下，距离下一次系统升级还差85145点。

路漫漫其修远兮。

第二天早上八点多，顾承安掐着点骑着他的电驴出发的，目的地是某安金融中心写字楼，早上上班人流密集，这个天搁那也凉快，适合测试他的智能眼镜。

路过一个十字路口，绿灯亮着，顾承安正准备跟车过路口，左侧传来一声刺耳的轮胎摩擦声。

他下意识侧头。

一辆黑色宝马5系，从左侧路口直接闯红灯冲出来，速度压根没减，和正常行驶的一辆私家车险些前脸贴前脸，双方同时猛打方向盘，两车擦身而过。

但宝马的惯性已经带偏了车头，整个车身横向甩进了非机动车道。

顾承安反应很快，猛扭电门加速，侧滑出去一米多，险险的避开了。

身后砰的一声，紧接着是第二声、第三声。

Gu Chengan took out the Dzi Bead from the space.

In the palm of my hand, I weighed it.

The weight has not changed, and there is no difference in appearance.Gu Chengan stood up and took out the smart glasses.

Follow the assistant's guidance, put the smart glasses and Dzi beads back into the system space, and start the adaptation and upgrade process.

Assistant Tip: It is estimated to take five minutes.

This time it was much faster.

After five minutes, he couldn't wait to take out the Dzi beads and smart glasses.

First hang the Dzi beads back on your neck.

Put on your glasses.

When you turn on the phone, the translucent interface in the upper right corner of the lens pops up, the same as before, but with an additional icon - a small dzi bead shape, hanging in the corner of the interface.

He connected his glasses to his phone via Bluetooth and clicked on the icon.

The information previously recorded by the Dzi Bead has all been synchronized, one by one, which is relatively clear.

But the function of real-time scanning markers that we really want has not yet been verified. After all, there is no target yet.

Gu Chengan took off his glasses and put them into the system space.

I'll go out for a spin tomorrow and test it out.

Today’s harvest is not bad: the money has arrived, important auxiliary equipment has been upgraded, and by the way, I also worked as a non-staff lifeguard in Dameisha.

Justice is worth it, I don’t know if I made any profit today.

He opened the system interface and took a look.

Justice value: 7555.

200 more.

Not bad, an unexpected bonus.

He calculated silently in his mind and found that there were still 85,145 points left before the next system upgrade.

The road is long and long.

At around eight o'clock the next morning, Gu Chengan set off on his electric donkey. His destination was an office building in an financial center. There were a lot of people going to work in the morning. It was cool on this day and there, which was suitable for testing his smart glasses.

Passing by an intersection, the green light was on. Gu Chengan was about to follow the car through the intersection when a harsh tire screeching sound came from the left side.

He turned his head subconsciously.

A black BMW 5 Series ran through the red light from the intersection on the left without slowing down at all. It was almost face to face with a private car that was driving normally. Both parties turned the steering wheel at the same time, and the two cars passed by each other.

However, the BMW's inertia had already deflected the front of the car, and the entire body was thrown sideways into the non-motorized lane.

Gu Chengan reacted quickly, turned the switch to accelerate, and slid sideways for more than a meter, narrowly avoiding it.

There was a bang behind him, followed by a second and a third.
